Definition: , a reduplicated and prolonged form of πράω; (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses) contracted from περάω (to traverse; from the base of G4008); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively):--sell.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
